req.title: Cookies domain restriction
req.statement: The system shall not include cookies whose Domain attribute excludes the request host when responding to /cookies.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /cookies must NOT include cookies whose Domain attribute excludes the request host. The Flask test client sends cookies via the Cookie header directly; the view_cookies handler reads request.cookies which only contains cookies the browser/client would send (i.e., domain-matched ones). We test: (1) positive - cookies sent in Cookie header appear in response JSON; (2) negative - cookies NOT sent in Cookie header (simulating domain exclusion) do NOT appear; (3) boundary - empty cookie jar yields empty cookies dict; (4) multiple cookies to verify exact set membership; (5) domain-restricted cookie absent from request yields absent from response. Mutations targeted: dict key presence/absence, status code comparisons, boolean logic in hide_env branch.

tests.name: test_cookies_present_in_request_appear_in_response
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Cookie header contains a valid name=value pair matching the request host
actions: Send GET /cookies with Cookie header containing 'session=abc123'
trace: R-HTTPBIN-033: cookies whose domain matches request host MUST appear
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_cookies_present_in_request_appear_in_response():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/cookies', headers={'Cookie': 'session=abc123'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert data['cookies'] == {'session': 'abc123'}

test_cookies_present_in_request_appear_in_response()

tests.name: test_domain_restricted_cookie_absent_only_matching_cookie_present
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Client sends only the domain-matching cookie; domain-restricted cookie is withheld
actions: Send GET /cookies with Cookie header containing only 'allowed=yes' (domain-restricted 'blocked=no' is NOT sent)
Assert 'blocked' key is absent and 'allowed' key is present with exact value
expected: 'blocked' key is NOT in cookies dict
trace: R-HTTPBIN-033: domain-restricted cookie excluded from request must not appear in /cookies response
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_domain_restricted_cookie_absent_only_matching_cookie_present():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/cookies', headers={'Cookie': 'allowed=yes'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert data['cookies'] == {'allowed': 'yes'}
    assert 'blocked' not in data['cookies']
    assert data['cookies'].get('allowed') == 'yes'
    assert len(data['cookies']) == 1

test_domain_restricted_cookie_absent_only_matching_cookie_present()

tests.name: test_response_structure_exact_keys
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Inspect top-level JSON keys and nested cookies dict
expected: Top-level JSON has exactly one key: 'cookies'
cookies dict has exactly one entry: {'x': 'boundary_val'}
trace: R-HTTPBIN-033: response structure must contain 'cookies' key; boundary of exactly one cookie
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_response_structure_exact_keys():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/cookies', headers={'Cookie': 'x=boundary_val'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    top_keys = list(data.keys())
    assert top_keys == ['cookies']
    assert data['cookies'] == {'x': 'boundary_val'}
    assert len(data['cookies']) == 1
    assert data['cookies']['x'] == 'boundary_val'

test_response_structure_exact_keys()
